verses.en: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;
verses.sm: Iuta ma Peniamina ua faia e tagata o le tafeaga le malumalu mo le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu;

verses.en: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.
verses.sm: ona latou o mai lea ia Serupapelu ma matai sili, ma ua latou faapea mai ia te i latou, Seʻi tatou faia ia le fale faatasi ma outou; auā ua matou saili atu i lo outou Atua, pei o outou; o i matou foi ua matou fai taulaga ia te ia, talu ona po o Esarata le tupu o Asuria, o le na aveina ae i matou iinei.

verses.en: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Serupapelu, ma Iosua, ma matai sili uma o Isaraelu ia te i latou, Tatou te le faia le fale o lo matou Atua ma outou; na o i matou nei lava matou te faia le fale o le Aw: le Atua o Isaraelu, pei ona fetalai mai le tupu o Kuresa le tupu o Peresia ia te i matou.

verses.en: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,
verses.sm: Ona faavaivaia lea o tagata o Iuta e tagata o le nuu, ma latou faaatuatuvaleina i latou a o faia le fale;

verses.en: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.sm: ua latou faaoloaina foi ni e faulalo e faalavelave ia te i latou, ina ia faaleaogaina ai la latou filifiliga, i aso uma o Kuresa le tupu o Peresia, e oo foi i le nofoaiga a Tariu le tupu o Peresia.

verses.en: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.sm: O le nofoaiga a Asueru, o le amataga o lana nofoaiga, ua tusi atu ai e i latou e momoli i e ua nonofo i Iuta ma Ierusalema.

verses.en: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.
verses.sm: O ona aso foi o Aretaseta sa tusi atu ai Piselama, o Metereta, o Taveele, ma i latou uma e na pule faatasi ma i latou, ia Aretaseta le tupu o Peresia; o upu foi o le tusi sa tusi i le gagana a Arama, sa faamatalaina foi i le gagana a Arama.

verses.en: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:
verses.sm: Ua tusi atu Rekumu le faamasino, ma Semesai le tusiupu, se tusi e momoli ai Ierusalema ia Aretaseta le tupu, ua faapea;

verses.en: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,
verses.sm: ona tusi atu lea o Rekumu le faamasino, ma Semesai le tusiupu, ma i latou uma e na pule faatasi ma i laua; o tagata o Tinai, ma tagata o Afareseka, o tagata o Tarepelai, o tagata o Afaresai, o tagata o Areka, o tagata o Papelonia, o tagata o Susana, o tagata o Tiavei, o tagata o Elama,

verses.en: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.
verses.sm: ma isi nuu uma na aumaia e Asenapa, o le alii tele ma le taʻua, ma na faanofoina i latou i aai o Samaria, ma i latou uma o i ona tala mai o le vaitafe, o ona po foi na tusi ai.

verses.en: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.
verses.sm: O le ata lenei o le tusi na avatu e i latou ia te ia, o le tupuo Aretaseta, O au auauna o tagata o i ona tala mai o le vaitafe, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.
verses.sm: la silafia e le tupu, o tagata o Iuta e na o ae ia te i matou mai ia te oe, ua oo mai i latou i Ierusalema le aai fouvale ma le matuā leaga, ua toe faia, ma ona pa ua faauma, ua soo foi ona faavae.

verses.en: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.
verses.sm: Ia silafia nei e le tupu, afai e toe faia lenei aai, a faaumaina foi ona pa, ona le avatu lea e i latou o taulaga, ma taulaga i mea eseese, ma taulaga o ala; ona iu ai lea ina faaitiitiina mea a tupu.

verses.en: Now because we have maintenance from the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
verses.sm: O lenei, ona ua aai i matou i mea mai le maota o le tupu, e le tatau ia i matou ona vaai i le faamativaina o le tupu; o le mea lea ua matou aauina atu ai nisi, ma matou faailoa atu ai i le tupu;

verses.en: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.
verses.sm: ina ia suesuea i le tusi a ou tama e faamanatu a“, ona e maua ai lea i le tusi e faamanatu a, ma e silafia ai, o lenei aai o le aai fouvale ma le ua leaga ai mea a tupu ma itu malo, ma latou faatupuina ai le fouvale talu anamua lava; o lea na faaumatia al lenei aai.

verses.en: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again, and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.
verses.sm: Ua matou faailoa atu i le tupu, afai e toe faia lenei aai, ma faaumaina ona pa, ona le toe ai lea sou tofi i lenei itu o le vaitafe.

verses.en: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.
verses.sm: Ona au mai lea e le tupu le tusi ia Rekumu le faamasino, ma Semesai le tusiupu, ma i larou uma ua pule faatasi ma i laua o e nonofo i Samaria, ma e o i le la itu o le vaitafe, la manuia outou, o ona po foi na tusi ai.

verses.en: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.
verses.sm: O le tusi na au mai e outou ia te i matou ua faitauina lava i oʻu luma.

verses.en: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
verses.sm: Ona ou fai atu ai lea, ona suesuea lea, ua iloa ai foi o lena aai ua faamaualuga i tupu talu anamua lava, ua faatupuina ai foi le fouvale ma le ‘ana‘ana.

verses.en: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
verses.sm: Sa i ai foi i lerusalema o tupu lima malolosi, o e na pule i nuu uma i ona tala atu o le vaitafe, sa avatua foi ia te i latou o taulaga, ma taulaga i mea eseese, ma taulaga o ala.

verses.en: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.
verses.sm: O lenei, ina poloai atu 1a O outou ia vaoia ia tagata, aua foi neʻi faia lena aai, seia ou tuuina atu se tasi poloaiga.

verses.en: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
verses.sm: Ia outou, neʻi outou faatamala i lenei mea; pe se a ea e tupu ai se leaga e faaitiitiina ai mea a tupu.

verses.en: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.
verses.sm: Ua faitauina le upu o le tusi a le tupu o Aretaseta i luma o Rekumu ma Semesai le tusiupu, ma e na pule faatasi ma i laua, ona latou o ai lea ua tele vavave i Ierusalema, i tagata o Iuta, ma Jatou vaoia i latou i le lima malosi.

verses.en: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.sm: Ona tuua ai lea o le galuega o le fale o le Atua o i Ierusalema. Ua tuua foi ua oo ile lua o tausaga o le nofoaiga a Tariu le tupu o Peresia.
